# Matthew Shirley — agent listing feed (staging)

> Machine-readable active commercial listings for Matthew Shirley, Associate Broker at Saurage Rotenberg Commercial Real Estate, LLC (SRCRE).

## Feeds
- /agents/listings.json — full feed (JSON)
- /agents/listings/{id}.json — one listing (8-character Louisiana Commercial Database (LACDB) id)
- /agents/listing-record.schema.json — JSON Schema
- /agents/how-to.md — how agents should read the feed and request a tour or Offering Memorandum (OM)
